_comment: Gateway rewrite rules for Qwen3.8's memorised Alibaba OSS proxy URL. Applied case-insensitively, in order, to the request history and to the model output (JSON and SSE). Patterns match within one URL-like token (no whitespace, quotes, brackets, backslashes or backticks). 'replacement' is used in model output, 'history' in the request history (plain words, so the model has no URL to copy); tool calls to these URLs are repaired first (see rewrite.repair_history). Replacements deliberately avoid the denied words..
